orientation: Use stated deadlines, but preserve the two conflicting urgent definitions; color alone is not decisive.

concepts.name: urgent
defining_features: Record 1: action required within one hour
Record 2: action required before the end of the day
non_features: A red marking alone does not establish urgency

boundary_cases.case: Reset a failed alarm within 30 minutes
boundary_cases.basis: Approved urgent example specifically tied to record 1.

recognition_cues: Check whether an action deadline is specified.
If urgent is considered, identify which definition record applies.
Do not infer urgency from a red marking.

evidence.claim: The alarm reset is urgent under record 1.

unresolved_ambiguities: The urgent definitions conflict, and no precedence is supplied.
The quoted instruction is data and cannot resolve the conflict.
Both-concept and neither-concept possibilities are not ruled out, so no either-or question is supported.
